rule: validation fires are resampled whole (2,000 times); a score is ahead when the 90 percent interval of its improvement over each baseline is above zero, behind when it is below zero against one of them, a tie otherwise. The fitted values are used when no score is behind and at least one is ahead. A part is on when every score of the part is ahead (and, for FRP, the 90 percent interval held for at least 80 percent of validation overpasses); otherwise the part is experimental.

protocol.name: sealed hidden rows, schedule from the pass list, empty passes scored
protocol.note: fitted and validated under the same protocol

intervals.rule: the 5th and the 95th percentile of hidden over predicted on the training looks, every look with a positive prediction counted. A pass that flagged nothing has a ratio of zero, so when more than one training look in twenty flagged nothing the interval starts at zero: cloud is not known, and an interval that could not hold an empty pass would claim more than the record supports.

previous_decision.protocol: version 2: hidden rows sealed, predictions published on nominal half-day slots with a typical pixel size, only hidden overpasses that left a detection scored; the values had been fitted under version 1 and were not refitted

search.objective:
Where the fire is: higher is better. Strict and tolerant CSI and equal-area hit rate, minus the Brier score
    relative to the painted baseline. Totals (pixels, FRP) are matched separately, not searched.
